high_level_description: stc brand style, a large indoor tech exhibition space filled with visitors and digital kiosks.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern exhibition hall with polished light gray concrete flooring, exposed industrial-style ceiling lighting and ductwork, white walls with large digital display panels, and purple and blue accent lighting throughout.

elements.desc: Multiple interactive kiosks with purple and black digital displays arranged in rows, featuring sleek glass and metal construction.
Visitors, including men and women wearing traditional Middle Eastern attire such as thobes and hijabs, filling the space.
Ceiling-mounted white LED text display naming the exhibition.
Ceiling-mounted white LED text display describing the exhibition theme.
